channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1477187: Microsoft OneDrive: OneDrive sync supports up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive sync on macOS will increase its item limit from 300,000 to 1 million per device, starting with a Public Preview in mid-October 2026 for Insiders ring users. Devices not meeting hardware requirements will remain at the current limit, with no disruption expected.

item.title: MC1515940: Microsoft OneDrive: Copilot actions in the File Explorer context menu are being retired
item.description: Microsoft is retiring several OneDrive Copilot actions from the File Explorer context menu by early December 2026, simplifying usage. Users can still access Copilot features via right-click "Ask Copilot," the File Explorer Home icon, or the OneDrive activity center. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1457226: Microsoft OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive for the web will adopt the modern SharePoint document library experience, featuring improved navigation and enhanced filtering across views. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing by late October. Changes are enabled by default, with no impact on permissions or policies; no user action required.

item.title: MC1288531: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a new export feature in the Agent Dashboard by mid-November 2026, allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to download de-identified Copilot agent usage data for up to six months. Admins can manage or disable this feature via Viva Feature Access Management.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps will update App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles starting mid-November 2026. Changes include role-based access control alignment with Defender XDR, affecting Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles. Admins should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by October 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; Gov rollout is paused. Hybrid/on-premises scenarios are excluded.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings starting early February 2027, enabling note-taking, agenda management, Q&A, and task management. The rollout is delayed from November 2026, requires no action, and affects organizations with Facilitator enabled and licensed users.

item.title: MC1470417: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
item.description: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with the planned Microsoft 365 Copilot feature for reviewing PDFs via the context menu in OneDrive iOS. This feature would have allowed users to select text in PDFs and use Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or customize prompts, requiring a Copilot license.

item.title: MC1483419: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Let representatives set next presence to handle routing of work items
item.description: We are announcing the ability to allow representatives to set next presence to indicate their future availability in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Next presence allows service representatives to queue their next availability status and stop receiving new assignments while the next presence status is pending. After all active conversations and work items are completed, the system automatically updates the re...

item.title: MC1478465: Security Copilot is now included as part of your Microsoft 365 E5/E7 plan
item.description: Updated October 19, 2026: We have identified that this message did not reach it's intended audience. You can safely disregard this message, and we apologize any confusion this may have caused.

item.title: MC1515939: Sending from Aliases
item.description: Sending from Aliases is now generally available in Exchange Online, allowing users to send emails from any mailbox alias. Admins can enable it via PowerShell or Exchange Admin Center. Additional features are being explored, and no compliance issues have been identified.

item.title: MC1515937: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery introduces three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution to help admins troubleshoot issues. Rolling out from October 2026 to February 2027 across environments. No admin action required; diagnostics do not alter configurations.

item.title: MC1515932: External Recipients Banner on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will display a banner warning when external attendees are added to meetings, rolling out worldwide from late October to late November 2026. This helps prevent accidental sharing with external recipients. No action or compliance changes are required.

item.title: MC1515931: Microsoft Teams: Simplified app enablement experience in Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft is launching a simplified app enablement experience in the Teams admin center by mid-October 2026. It offers a guided flow for managing app access, installation, and permissions, reducing steps for admins. Existing settings remain unchanged until admins apply updates. No prior action is needed.

item.title: MC1515930: Cowork browser use setting renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot
item.description: The Cowork settings panel in Microsoft Copilot is renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot to improve discoverability. This change, rolling out in mid-October 2026, does not affect functionality or configurations. No action is required; admins will find the setting under the new name.

item.title: MC1515929: Microsoft Teams: GitHub app consolidation and legacy GitHub app deprecation
item.description: Microsoft Teams is consolidating GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into a single GitHub app, deprecating the legacy app by November 16, 2026. Users must update or replace the old apps with the new GitHub app, which integrates repository updates and Copilot features. Admins should manage app access and update policies accordingly.

item.title: RM500378: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro. Note: An earlier listing incorrectly stated this feature applied to webinars as well. That experience is still in development and will be released later in 202...

item.title: RM502525: Microsoft Teams: Simplified device settings for voice and face recognition on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: It's easier for admins to enable the benefits of intelligent audio and video and Copilot for users in Teams Rooms through a new user interface and admin settings. These new settings, on the device and in the Pro Management portal, simplify configuration and remove the requirement to use PowerShell, offering improved visibility across rooms.

item.title: RM534609: Microsoft Purview: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
item.description: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK enables developers to seamlessly integrate enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance into the AI agents they build. This integration enables automatic classification and protection of sensitive data, prevents data leaks and oversharing, and provides visibility and control for regulatory compliance—empowering organizations to confidently and securely adopt AI agents in complex environments.

item.title: RM536576: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
item.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

item.title: RM542181: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
item.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

item.title: RM558922: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
item.description: You’ll notice media quality improvements including support for up to 16 participant videos (4×4 grid) available in May and simulcast streaming (June) when using Direct Guest Join. These updates make cross‑platform meetings more immersive and reliable when joining Teams meetings from Zoom, Google Meet, or Cisco devices. Direct Guest Join is not yet available for Google Meet on Teams Rooms for Android.

item.title: RM559107: Microsoft Viva: [Engage] Pinned resources & related communities in Teams for iOS
item.description: Users will be able to see a community's pinned resources and related communities in Teams for iOS.

item.title: RM559605: Microsoft Teams: Improved organization for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams automatically organizes your chats with new built in sections that help reduce clutter and keep conversations easy to find. Muted chats (on by default) are grouped together in a dedicated area, while meeting chats (off by default) can be collected into a single section for quick access. You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences. item.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. item.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. item.title: RM562412: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
item.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

item.title: RM562534: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.

item.description: Ability to apply Retention labels and policies to items on OneDrive and SharePoint based on when the items were last accessed by an user.

item.title: RM567884: Microsoft Teams: External phone call routing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: External call routing will provide users the ability to redirect all external phone calls to either voicemail or their unanswered settings.

item.title: RM570427: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
item.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

item.title: RM570646: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic...

item.title: RM570651: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts
item.description: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

item.title: RM570652: Work IQ: Agent Policy Governance
item.description: Provide administrators with policy-based controls for governing agents and their capabilities at scale.

item.title: RM570665: Outlook: Send availability in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: We are bringing back send availability on both iOS and Android. iOS users will now also be able to access more of this feature via keyboard and voiceover.

item.title: RM570666: Outlook: Duplicate events in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: We are adding the ability to duplicate an event. Simply go to the event details and select "duplicate event"

item.title: RM570672: Work IQ: Human in the loop
item.description: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

item.title: RM570845: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

item.title: RM571305: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
item.description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.

item.title: RM573149: PowerPoint: Set slide size in a modern PowerPoint pane
item.description: Change slide size in PowerPoint from a modern task pane that keeps you in the flow of editing with real-time slide changes. Choose common slide sizes including new social media presets, or customize dimensions with a cleaner, more approachable experience.

item.title: RM573150: PowerPoint: Set slide size in a modern task pane
item.description: Change slide size in PowerPoint from a modern task pane that keeps you in the flow of editing with real-time slide changes. Choose common slide sizes including new social media presets, or customize dimensions with a cleaner, more approachable experience.

item.title: RM574121: Microsoft Dataverse: Add users without licenses to activity recipient fields
item.description: Enable active Microsoft Entra users without Dataverse or Power Apps licenses as activity recipients. Created user records remain disabled and do not grant Dynamics 365 app access.

item.title: RM576199: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

item.title: RM576272: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on GitHub Copilot Harness
item.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the GitHub Copilot Harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

item.title: RM576278: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Complete zero-effort tasks
item.description: Zero-effort task completion enables project managers and team members to mark tasks as complete even when no effort was planned or recorded. This capability supports milestones, administrative activities, checklists, and other tasks that track completion without requiring work hours.

item.title: RM576286: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
item.description: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.

item.title: RM576709: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage!

item.title: RM576711: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
item.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

item.title: MC1515917: Database Hub in Fabric: Default enablement and admin opt-out
item.description: Microsoft Fabric will enable Database Hub by default on November 17, 2026, allowing authorized users to access database insights without admin activation. Admins can opt out via the Fabric admin portal. No databases or permissions change, and usage remains subject to existing roles and licensing.

item.title: MC1469565: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for archive mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online by April 2027 and expanding Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes. Organizations must migrate applications from EWS to Microsoft Graph APIs by October 2026 to maintain archive mailbox access, compliance, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle management.

item.title: MC1302905: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
item.description: Microsoft has paused the rollout of integrating the Microsoft Purview SDK into the Agent Framework SDK, which enables AI agents to enforce Purview compliance and data protection. This integration requires developer implementation and affects organizations building AI agents with Purview licenses. No immediate admin action is needed if not developing AI agents.

item.title: MC1472601: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will allow admins to archive inactive SharePoint files under retention policies starting early December 2026. Archived files move to Microsoft 365 Archive, remain compliant and discoverable, and are excluded from Copilot indexing to improve response relevance. This feature requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, displaying more presenters simultaneously. This update, rolling out from mid-August to October 2026, improves event production efficiency without requiring admin action.

item.title: MC1443517: Microsoft Teams: External presenters can manage event production controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams now allows event organizers to grant production control permissions to trusted external presenters, including federated (B2B) and guest users, enabling them to manage event production controls. This feature, rolling out August–November 2026, enhances collaboration with external partners without automatic changes to existing events.

item.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. Rollout begins July 2026, with general availability by October 2026. The feature is enabled by default, requires no action, and maintains the existing experience for smaller meetings.

item.title: MC1266027: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new minimized meeting experience by late October 2026, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without reopening the full window. Two minimized views—expanded (shows up to four videos) and compact (no videos)—are enabled by default, with no impact on screen sharing.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. Rollout begins early June 2026, enabling branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1473153: Microsoft Teams: New centralized experience for organizing important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a centralized resource management experience in chats and channels, allowing users to pin and organize resources below headers and access them on mobile. The "In this chat" and "In this channel" panes will be removed. Rollout occurs from late September to mid-November 2026.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable archiving SharePoint files based on retention policies, moving inactive content to Microsoft 365 Archive to reduce storage costs while maintaining compliance and discoverability. Archived content is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026; admin configuration is required.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with further customization options. Rollout occurs from October to December 2026 across environments. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve notification control and reduce noise.

item.title: MC1506727: Microsoft Agent 365: Expanded access to Microsoft agent usage and activity insights in Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: Starting late October 2026, Microsoft 365 admin center will expand access to usage and activity insights for Microsoft-built or platform-based agents, regardless of Agent 365 licensing. This provides foundational visibility into agent metrics, while full management features still require paid licenses. Rollout completes by late November 2026.

item.title: MC1191578: Update to EWS Access for Kiosk / Frontline Worker Licenses
item.description: The planned October 1, 2026, enforcement to block Exchange Web Services (EWS) access for Kiosk and Frontline Worker licenses will not proceed. Previously, these licenses lacked EWS rights, but restrictions were unenforced; now, the change is canceled to avoid inconvenience.

item.title: RM476488: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
item.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

item.title: RM513275: Microsoft Viva: Engage Community feed improvements
item.description: Align the community feeds default experience with expected user behaviors; support triage and content review for users who want to read every message in a community.

item.title: RM519571: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
item.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot ex...

item.title: RM529851: Outlook: Enriching profile cards with custom, organization-specific properties
item.description: Customers can now customize their M365 profile cards by adding custom properties unique to their organization. These properties can be sourced from external systems like HR platforms, enriching user profiles with relevant organizational details. Tenant admins can configure these properties with a display name and icon, which will appear in the Contact Information section of the profile cards.

item.title: RM557561: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
item.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. item.title: RM567314: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint app in Teams
item.description: When a user who has access to the SharePoint app in Teams clicks a SharePoint page or news link in Teams chat or channels, the link will open inside the SharePoint app in Teams (if available) instead of the mobile browser

item.title: RM574110: Microsoft Teams: Events now support up to 20,000 registrations, making it easier to reach and engage larger audiences at scale
item.description: Connect with more attendees than ever before with Teams Events, now supporting up to 20,000 registrations for organizers with valid Attendee packs.

item.title: RM575292: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 reporting availability for Microsoft platform agents
item.description: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license. Customers will be able to view reporting on their Microsoft platform-built agents in one consolidated picture, along with context on who built each agent and why.

item.title: RM576178: Power Apps: Access updated visuals for row summaries across forms and views
item.description: The row summaries experience has a refreshed layout that makes AI-generated insights more prominent and easier to consume. Improved visual hierarchy (including clearer spacing, background and border treatments, status indicators, and generation labels) helps summaries stand apart from surrounding form sections so users can quickly identify key information.

item.title: RM576193: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
item.description: Get a closer look at shared content in Teams calls and meetings with pinch-to-zoom using your touchpad. Quickly zoom in to make small text and detailed visuals easier to see, then zoom back out for the full view. Existing zoom controls remain available.

item.title: RM576194: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
item.description: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes. This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

item.title: RM576198: Microsoft Teams: Near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes in messages
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce near-real-time detection of malicious QR codes shared in messages. By analyzing destinations embedded in QR codes, Teams can identify potential phishing and fraud threats and apply additional protections to malicious content, extending existing URL protection to QR-based attacks.

item.title: RM576298: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Import task - Import at a given hierarchy in the task grid
item.description: This feature gives project managers greater control over where imported tasks are placed within a project plan. From the task grid, a project manager can open the context menu for an existing task and select Insert task below. The standard Import Tasks pane then opens and confirms the selected insertion point.

item.title: MC1510951: Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada
item.description: Windows updates are available to support 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia, effective November 1, 2026. Devices must install updates and select new region-specific time zones to avoid incorrect local time. Guidance for Outlook and interim steps are provided.

item.title: MC1193692: Microsoft 365: Enrich profile cards with custom properties from third-party systems
item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft 365 admins can add up to 10 custom properties from external systems to user profile cards via Microsoft Graph People connectors. This feature is off by default, requires configuration, and enhances profile information in Outlook Web to improve collaboration context.

item.title: MC1411727: Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
item.description: Copilot Notebooks will proactively suggest relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, speeding content creation. Available by default to eligible users from early July 2026 (preview) and late August 2026 (general availability). No admin action required; future support for PDFs and Pages planned.

item.title: MC1511072: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming change to voicemail message delivery by email
item.description: Microsoft Teams will change voicemail email delivery by early March 2027, moving caller info from the email From field to the Subject line and allowing organizations to use their own domains for sending. Organizations should update mail-flow rules accordingly; no new compliance requirements arise.

item.title: MC1511071: Action required: Review property changes for Exchange Online scenarios
item.description: Exchange Online is deprecating certain properties in Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration cmdlets starting November 15, 2026. Organizations must review and update scripts or workflows using these properties before then to avoid disruptions. Full details and guidance are provided in the linked Microsoft documentation.

item.title: MC1511056: Microsoft Copilot Studio – Teams app retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Copilot Studio app in Teams by February 2027, transitioning all chatbot agent creation and management to the Copilot Studio web app. Editing in Teams ends January 2027. Users and admins should switch to the web app and update related documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1511052: Upcoming changes to Agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: SharePoint and OneDrive agents using the .agent file format will be upgraded to integrate with Microsoft Copilot’s extensibility ecosystem. From mid-November 2026, new agents use the Copilot Agent Builder, with .agent files supported until March 2027, after which they stop working. Organizations should prepare to upgrade agents and adopt new management and governance tools.

item.title: RM576886: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Boost technician productivity - Disable clickthrough on lookup values in forms
item.description: A new option in the lookup control lets you disable clickthrough on the displayed lookup value. When disabled, the lookup value renders as plain text (not a hyperlink), preventing users from unintentionally opening the related record. This applies to forms across web and mobile.

item.title: RM576884: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize multiple resources with Scheduling Operations Agent
item.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. Dispatchers can review and compare the proposed schedules with the current schedules before applying changes.

Users can still choose their preferred feed and sort order, with settings saved across communities. Unread indicators will appear in both new and all feeds. No action required.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by late January 2027, automatically displaying enrolled in-room participants’ names and contact cards to remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meeting clarity. The feature requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

item.title: MC1474110: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Microsoft Planner's new Capacity view, launching late October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 licensed users on web and desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; users should keep task details updated.

item.title: MC1443514: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
item.description: Planner Agent chat is being added to Microsoft Planner basic plans, enabling users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to interact via natural language for plan management, insights, and task updates. Rollout begins September 2026, with admin controls to enable or block access.

item.title: MC1506734: Microsoft Teams: Video sharing from OneDrive in Teams events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will soon allow event organizers and producers to share videos directly from OneDrive during Teams events using "Manage what attendees see," enabling smoother, higher-quality playback without screen sharing. Rollout begins November 2026; no action is required, but informing organizers and updating guidance is recommended.

item.title: MC1387578: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 globally, with no changes to message classification or custom templates. No action is required.

item.title: MC1155311: Viva Engage: Agents in Viva Engage communities Public Preview
item.description: Viva Engage Community Agents are in public preview, allowing admins to add AI agents that draft answers using community and selected SharePoint content. Features include tagging by members, analytics, and configurable posting modes. General availability and network-wide settings will be announced later; admins can opt in via the Engage admin center.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. The rollout starts mid-October 2026 for supported browsers like Edge and Chrome, requiring no admin action but user awareness and supported browser versions.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces Facilitator, an AI feature that detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings by providing relevant answers via web search in the chat. Available from December 2026, it requires Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) and must be manually enabled. Admin controls and user opt-out are supported.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling default file attachment (paperclip and drag-and-drop) in external chats, storing files in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment per existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Organizations can opt out via Teams PowerShell. Existing sharing restrictions remain unchanged. User training and policy review are recommended.

item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts early November 2026, completing by mid-November. Users can enable, disable, and reorder these sections; no admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1509121: Choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes
item.description: We are announcing the ability to choose the data sources AI-powered Data Enrichment uses, including CRM notes in Dynamics 365 Apps. This feature will reach general availability on October 23, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables admins to choose which data sources agents use to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and agents keep running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need t...

item.title: MC1173208: Microsoft Copilot Analytics: Data export public preview for Copilot metrics in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a default-on public preview of a data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. It enables export of de-identified, weekly Copilot usage metrics from the past six months to analyze adoption and optimize licensing. Requires 50+ Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow enabling admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out from mid-2026, it helps reduce data exposure while maintaining compliance and requires explicit admin configuration.

item.title: MC1508238: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra security groups
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable sensitivity labels for Microsoft Entra cloud security groups starting mid-November 2026, allowing administrators to apply and enforce governance policies on these groups. Labels can be assigned via multiple platforms, cannot yet be changed once applied, and require separate tenant configuration from Microsoft 365 groups.

item.title: MC1508235: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Count of labeled documents condition for Exchange Online
item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP introduces a new Exchange Online condition to detect emails with a high count of sensitivity-labeled attachments, enhancing data protection. Available from November 2026, it allows admins to set thresholds for labeled files in emails, combining volume and content signals for better DLP policy enforcement.

item.title: MC1508234: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
item.description: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show only automatic recording and transcription settings allowed by assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. This change, rolling out November-December 2026, improves policy compliance and reduces confusion. No admin action is needed; communication to organizers is recommended.

item.title: MC1508229: Microsoft Excel: Changes to Get Data from Web (Legacy) experience
item.description: Microsoft Excel will phase out the legacy Get Data from Web experience starting January 2027, encouraging use of the newer version with enhanced features. Existing legacy queries will still refresh, but new or edited legacy queries will be disabled. Users should update training and consider migrating queries to the new experience.

item.title: RM168524: Microsoft Teams: Co-organizer updates in Webinars
item.description: Co-organizers can edit webinar details, publish the event, and cancel the event, similar to the organizer.

item.title: RM532720: Microsoft Teams: Organization Evaluation Score for Apps and Agents
item.description: Today, IT admins manually review trust data for Teams apps and agents in the Teams admin center to ensure they meet organizational security, privacy, and compliance standards. This feature introduces a scalable, automated evaluation process. Admins can define their organization’s trust requirements once, and the system will automatically assess each app and agent—generating an evaluation score and detailed evaluation report tailored to those requirements. This enables faster, more consistent dec...

item.title: RM561032: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – New Guided Experience to Diagnose and Resolve DLP Issues
item.description: We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected. This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document, including which policies were triggered, the order of evaluation, and detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.

item.title: RM569206: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
item.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

item.title: RM569934: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: RM570846: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
item.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

item.title: RM572676: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
item.description: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

item.title: RM573168: Planner: Planner Agent in Copilot V2 Improvements
item.description: Planner Agent brings Planner’s intelligent work management directly into Copilot Chat, enabling users to create, update, and manage personal tasks and shared basic plans without switching context. Integrated across Microsoft 365, it provides insights into priorities, deadlines, and at-risk work, along with interactive task cards to help users stay organized and keep work moving.

item.title: RM573245: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Out of the box real time translation on digital channels
item.description: With this feature, users get an out-of-the-box solution for translation services, so they don't need to bring their own web resources. Service representatives get updated feature usage with more configurations. They can tailor their conversations more accurately based on their existing skills and preferences. The feature is transparent yet modernized with new settings, making conversations easier to consume in a language of the representative's choice.

item.title: RM573266: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality evaluation - One-Time Evaluation Frequency
item.description: Quality evaluation plans now support a Once frequency type for both case evaluations and conversation evaluations. When creating an evaluation plan, users can select Once from the Frequency type dropdown to run the evaluation a single time instead of on a recurring schedule or trigger-based cadence.

item.title: RM574111: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot response personalization - Memory citations
item.description: When Copilot Chat uses memory to personalize a response, users can now see what informed the answer. Select Sources beneath the response, then open the Personalization tab to view the custom instructions, saved memories, memories learned from conversations, and past chats that shaped the response. From there, users can return to a cited chat to pick up where they left off or review and delete saved memories. Memory citations appear only when memory is turned on.

item.title: RM575288: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

item.title: RM576195: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

item.title: RM576395: Power Pages: Design studio - Enhance OpenID Connect with encrypted token support
item.description: This feature adds support for token-level encryption during authentication, allowing Power Pages to accept encrypted ID tokens in addition to signed tokens. It ensures secure claim transmission, improves compatibility with advanced identity providers, and strengthens overall authentication security without changing existing sign-in flows.

item.title: MC1506982: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for all channels
item.description: We've released updates to the following update channels for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel Monthly Enterprise Channel Semi-Annual Enterprise Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out these updates of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on those update channels starting October 13th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is require...

item.title: MC1450134: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors
item.description: Microsoft Entra will recognize Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors starting early October 2026, allowing users to meet MFA requirements without additional passkeys. No configuration changes are needed, but organizations should update onboarding and MFA registration guidance accordingly.

item.title: RM472030: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention based on Last Accessed for files in OneDrive and SharePoint
item.description: This creates the ability to apply Retention to each SharePoint or OneDrive item based on when it was last accessed by a user. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM501292: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): User can use Hubspot Connector in Researcher
item.description: The HubSpot connector allows users using the Researcher agent to be able to leverage 3rd party information from HubSpot to enrich generated responses with relevant information.

item.title: RM558286: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
item.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

item.title: RM558435: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
item.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

item.title: RM558933: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
item.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

item.title: RM561327: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

item.title: RM562016: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
item.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

item.title: RM562340: Microsoft Teams: Preloaded video for Teams Events and Meetings
item.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

item.title: RM564617: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
item.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validat...

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

item.title: RM568067: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
item.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

item.title: RM569209: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: You will now be able to add multiple steps to your workflow when building one from scratch.

item.title: RM570429: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey taking experience refinements
item.description: This feature is a collection of improvements including updates to the auto-save experience for comments, simplifying survey navigation through buttons by consolidating the "Skip" and "Done" buttons into a single "Next" button, and to give the survey taker greater control over question progression by refining the auto-scroll behavior when updating answers to questions.

item.title: RM570673: Work IQ: Retrieve
item.description: Enable agents to retrieve relevant Microsoft 365 content and context through Work IQ.

item.title: RM570851: Work IQ: A2A and MCP long running tasks
item.description: Enable durable long-running A2A and MCP tasks with progress tracking, later result retrieval, and cancellation.

item.title: RM570852: Work IQ: A2A and MCP elicitation
item.description: Enable A2A and MCP tasks to request missing information or authorization and then resume.

item.title: RM570868: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools
item.description: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.

item.title: RM570870: Work IQ: Microsoft IQ
item.description: Provide a unified intelligence layer that helps agents discover, reason over, and use organizational knowledge.

item.title: RM571681: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for the mail app
item.description: Extends the Fluent-based modern, refreshed look for model-driven apps to the mail app, providing consistent controls, spacing, colors, and visual treatment when users work in that app. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM571682: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for embedded model-driven apps
item.description: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: RM572673: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Extended rollback support for Monthly Enterprise Channel
item.description: Cloud Update is expanding rollback options for devices on Monthly Enterprise Channel. Administrators will be able to roll back devices to a release from two versions prior, with the latest available security updates for that release, and keep devices in the rolled-back state across subsequent releases until they are ready to resume updates. This provides additional time to investigate and resolve compatibility issues while maintaining security coverage and centralized control through the Microso...

item.title: RM572682: Power Apps: Control information density in model-driven apps
item.description: Model-driven apps now support configurable display density settings that let users choose how information is spaced throughout the application. Users can select from three density options:

item.title: RM573277: Power Pages: Create Power Pages SPA site from the Power Pages studio
item.description: Quickly get started with modern single-page application (SPA) development by creating a site directly from Power Pages Studio. Continue building and customizing your experience using your preferred development tools and frameworks.

item.title: RM573625: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC, GCC High and DoD
item.description: All users in Events larger than 1,000 users or in any Event optimized for a large audience can now chat with one another in a public event chat in GCC, GCC High and DoD.

item.title: RM573698: Outlook: Copilot Chat available in shared and delegate mailboxes
item.description: Shared mailbox users and delegates with read and manage (full access) and/or mail folder-level permission will now be able to access Copilot Chat directly from their shared and delegate mailboxes in classic Outlook, when added as a resource.

item.title: RM573705: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Procurement Agent - Define custom scenarios for agent-generated supplier emails
item.description: Business end-users and buyers can define and maintain their own outbound follow-up scenarios and use them wherever built-in scenarios are used today:

item.title: RM574094: Microsoft Teams: View files and conversations side by side
item.description: Review shared files without losing conversation context. When you open a PDF, Markdown, or HTML file from a Teams chat or channel message, the conversation appears alongside the file and takes you directly to where it was shared, allowing you to catch up on the discussion and respond without closing the file preview or switching back to chat.

item.title: RM574104: Power Apps: Manage model-driven app AI features from consolidated settings
item.description: Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.

item.title: RM574116: Dynamics 365 Finance: Collaborative comments for planning cubes and dimensions
item.description: Create and manage contextual discussion threads directly on planning cubes and dimensions. Users can comment on dimension cells, detailed or aggregate cube cells, and reporting rows; reply to and mention colleagues; receive email notifications; and resolve or reactivate discussions. Public and private visibility options, together with an All Comments view, filters, export, and role-based management actions, support collaboration throughout the planning cycle.

item.title: RM574117: Dynamics 365 Finance: Manage dimension security with Microsoft Entra groups
item.description: Administrators can now assign Microsoft Dataverse group teams backed by Microsoft Entra groups to Business performance planning dimension security groups. Previously, dimension security assignments were limited to individual users. The updated experience allows administrators to view and add eligible Entra group-backed teams alongside users, with separate membership information for each assignment type.

item.title: RM574118: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved planning writeback performance and flexibility
item.description: Business performance planning improves the performance and flexibility of writeback from the Matrix visual.

item.title: RM574124: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Enable MCP tools for POS returns
item.description: This feature provides reusable MCP tools for Store Commerce POS returns. These tools expose Commerce return capabilities as structured actions that customers, partners, and agent developers can use to build conversational or agentic return experiences.

item.title: RM574125: Visio: Desktop Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
item.description: The Microsoft Visio Desktop MCP Server enables compatible AI clients to connect with the Visio Desktop application to create, read, and update Visio diagrams using natural language. It runs locally on Windows and requires a licensed Visio Desktop application.

item.title: RM574363: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling for legacy Office files
item.description: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling will support legacy Microsoft Office file formats, including Word (.doc), Excel (.xls), and PowerPoint (.ppt). Organizations can automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

item.title: RM575287: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Admin Units Support for Copilot & Cowork DLP
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is extending Administrative Units support to Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork. This enables organizations to delegate management of supported Copilot DLP policies to administrators within their assigned Administrative Units, supporting regional, departmental, and regulatory boundaries without granting tenant-wide policy-management permissions. Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply, and configuration is optional for organizations cho...

item.title: RM575298: SharePoint: Agent chat web part
item.description: This is a new web part available for modern page editors in SharePoint. The web part can be configured to use any M365 Copilot agent.

item.title: MC1326509: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is releasing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS to enable sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing, matching Windows capabilities. Public preview starts May 29, 2026; general rollout begins January 2027. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially. No immediate action required.

item.title: MC1506735: Microsoft Planner: AI-generated status reports in Planner Agent
item.description: Microsoft Planner now includes AI-generated status reports via Planner Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot, summarizing plan progress, risks, and next steps. Users with a Copilot license can customize and generate reports from accessible plan data. Rollout starts late October 2026, with no required user action.

item.title: MC1506733: Action may be required: Review who can create agents in Microsoft Entra
item.description: Starting November 4, 2026, default users in Microsoft Entra can create agent blueprints unless administrators disable this via the "Users can create agent blueprints" setting. Admins can restrict this by toggling the setting to No in the Entra admin center before rollout completes in late November.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates like improved icons, spacing, and alignment starting early November 2026, enhancing clarity and consistency without changing workflows. No admin action is needed; users and help desks should be informed of appearance changes. These updates do not replace the classic experience.

item.title: MC1506728: Microsoft Entra: Changes to AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission for agent identities
item.description: Starting November 4, Microsoft Entra will stop automatically granting the AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager permission to agent blueprints. Admin consent will be required for agents to create identities. This change, rolling out worldwide in November 2026, enhances control and auditability of agent identity creation.

item.title: MC1440972: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Microsoft Edge is upgrading the Copilot new tab page to integrate Microsoft 365 Copilot chat, web search, and work content in one experience with enhanced chat, compose features, suggested actions, and a refreshed design. Rollout begins late September 2026, requiring a Copilot license and admin enablement.

item.title: MC1381121: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Policy sync and device health AI skill
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention will introduce AI-powered policy sync and device health insights to improve troubleshooting and policy enforcement visibility. The rollout is paused; no immediate action is needed. The feature requires Security Copilot and enhances compliance monitoring with AI-driven root cause analysis and remediation recommendations.

item.title: MC1469329: Build apps in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio and Copilot Cowork preview app-building with natural-language AI, enabling makers to create, test, and publish apps using organizational data and policies. Copilot Credits manage usage and billing. Admins control access and governance via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout started September 2026.

item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files
item.description: Microsoft Purview will enable retention policies based on the "last accessed" date for Office files in OneDrive and SharePoint, starting preview in January 2027 and general availability by March 2027. This helps delete obsolete data and improve Microsoft 365 Copilot responses, with no admin action required before rollout.

item.title: MC1506229: Dynamics 365 Apps - Add users without licenses to activity recipient fields (preview)
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable active Microsoft Entra users without Dataverse or Power Apps licenses as activity recipients. Created user records remain disabled and do not grant Dynamics 365 app access. This feature will reach public preview on October 15, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature enabled, active Entra ID users who do not have a valid Dynamics 365 or Power Apps license can be selected in fields such as: Email: To, Cc, and Bcc Appointment: Owner, Required Attende...

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, enhancing visibility and providing AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins late October 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but communication to users is recommended.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting. The update, rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, requires no action and provides clearer visibility into access evaluations for administrators.

item.title: MC1484010: Microsoft Teams: Hide organizer names in calendar view on Teams Panels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Panels will add an admin setting to show or hide organizer names in Calendar View, configurable via the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or panel device. This feature, available with Teams Rooms Pro and Shared Spaces licenses, launches worldwide in early October 2026.

item.title: MC1437671: Microsoft Entra: Allow password change after secure sign-in with My Sign-Ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra will enable users to change passwords after secure sign-in using strong credentials (passkey, FIDO2, Windows Hello) without knowing the current password or using SSPR. This feature, disabled by default, requires admin activation and will roll out globally from October to November 2026.

item.title: MC1505610: Public CDN is becoming optional during Brand Center setup
item.description: Brand Center setup will no longer require enabling Public CDN by default, allowing organizations to use branding governance without it. Public CDN remains necessary for font features and must be explicitly enabled. This change rolls out worldwide in October 2026 with no action required unless fonts are used.

item.title: MC1505609: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Apps: Retirement of App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com by November 30, 2026, consolidating app creation into Copilot Cowork and Microsoft Copilot Studio. New app creation in retired platforms ends mid-October 2026. Organizations must migrate existing apps before retirement using upcoming in-product migration tools.

item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules that auto-reply with saved templates, automating routine responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1505599: Microsoft Purview Audit: AuditLogQuery API generally available and Search-UnifiedAuditLog retiring
item.description: The Microsoft Graph AuditLogQuery API will be generally available in October 2026, replacing the Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell cmdlet, which will retire on October 15, 2027. Organizations using Search-UnifiedAuditLog must migrate to the API to avoid disruptions, as future audit search enhancements will focus on the API.

item.title: RM480725: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
item.description: AI citations analytics will help you track the usage of SP documents, news and pages through copilot and AI agents. You will be able to see how often a page or a file is referenced in a copilot response. You can also get insights into SharePoint site content getting referenced in copilot responses aggregated at the site level.

item.title: RM485731: Microsoft 365: Use Copilot in your search tab in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: Quickly find your files and leverage Copilot to get a better understanding within the search tab on the go. This item is no longer accurate and is being removed from the roadmap. We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: RM498640: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Capture voice notes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: With a Microsoft 365 Copilot license, transform offline discussions into structured, actionable, and searchable content with voice notes in Copilot.

item.title: RM518289: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint and Viva Insights Integration - Continuous employee engagement for leaders and managers with workplace metrics
item.description: Stay connected to your team’s engagement with Viva Insights Workplace Metrics, available alongside your survey results in Viva Glint. item.description: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place instead of multiple plans. item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Installation unification starts late September 2026, synchronizing settings without admin action for eligible tenants.

item.description: The Send Availability feature is restored in Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS, allowing users to share their meeting availability easily while composing emails. iOS users can also access it via the keyboard and VoiceOver. The update is available worldwide with no action required.

item.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data on your Windows endpoint devices. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP and PDF (image only PDF).

item.title: RM499898: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Viva Engage - Community Agent
item.description: Community Agent helps members get answers to questions in Viva Engage communities using community knowledge and connected sources. Community admins can choose to require human review before answers are posted or allow automatic posting.

item.description: A modern experience for the New Tab Page (NTP) on Microsoft Edge for Business.

item.description: Site owners have a critical role to play in ensuring accuracy of site information, including the site's necessity, its owners, members, permissions, and sharing settings. item.title: RM561922: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal

item.description: Configure the connectors your agent needs, with a simple in-chat sign-in instead of a full settings experience.

item.title: RM570439: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

item.title: RM570442: Outlook: Improved SharePoint file experience in file picker in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: Users can more easily work with SharePoint files in Outlook by saving email attachments directly to SharePoint and searching across SharePoint sites for files from the file picker.

item.title: RM570467: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

item.title: RM570669: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
item.description: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.

item.title: RM573220: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
item.description: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.

item.description: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. Buyers can add table joins and use fields from those tables as filter conditions, providing greater flexibility to determine which purchase order lines qualify for supplier follow-up based on their organization’s processes and data.

item.title: RM573706: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat

item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

item.title: RM574119: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved Matrix visual performance for large table
item.description: Business Performance Planning introduce Virtualization to optimizes how the Matrix visual renders large planning datasets. Rather than loading and displaying the entire dataset at once, the visual progressively renders the rows and columns needed as users scroll, expand, collapse, and navigate through the Matrix. This reduces the amount of data processed by the browser at any one time and helps maintain visual responsiveness at scale.

Validation before the deadline is recommended.

item.description: We're rolling out new capabilities for Copilot Notebook audio overview that make it easier to navigate longer content with topic-based episodes, new audio formats such as Critique and Debate, support enterprise information protection with sensitivity labels, and expand audio overview context to more content types.

item.title: RM573169: Microsoft Viva: Expanded agent coverage in Agent Dashboard

item.title: RM573252: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Cancel packing slips for stocked item requirements
